gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-ottoman-: Round, marker-drawn letters with a minimal jump to lowercase. Noto Serif Ottoman Siyaq sits below as a classic serif, its bowls swelling only slightly, while Autour One carries the loud, expressive part.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-sinhala: Noto Serif Sinhala has a tall band of letters with short stalks above, and its strokes vary just enough to feel alive. Autour One answers with horizontals as thick as its verticals; enlarge the Noto Serif Sinhala text a notch if that tall band feels tight.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-telugu: Bold, rounded and loud, Autour One shows no thick-thin flicker at all. And Noto Serif Telugu, a text serif with tall lowercase nearly reaching its capitals, adds a visible but restrained gap between its heavy and light strokes.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-thai: Noto Serif Thai has bodies that dominate the line, ascenders hardly showing, and a mellow range of stroke weights like etched glass lines. Autour One's bent-wire rounds make the sharper foil.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-tibetan: Loud, round and expressive, Autour One crosses its t with a bar matching the stem, while the serif body below tapers like a sharpened pencil. Autour One shouts best; Noto Serif Tibetan reads quietly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-todhri: Autour One brings a monoline skeleton and bold, expressive rounds. Noto Serif Todhri, a classic serif with a sizable x-height, settles underneath with a restful line whose modest swings in weight give the heading something to push against.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-toto: Chalky, heavy and dignified, the lowercase here looks pressed hard onto the board. Noto Serif Toto carries it with subtle modulation, and Autour One skips any calligraphic thinning, staying bold and flat-lined beside it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-vithkuqi: Autour One draws plain constant-width lines. Noto Serif Vithkuqi, a classic serif with big round bowls and stems a touch heavier than its crossbars, would carry a longer passage with a faint nib-pressure life.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-yezidi: Editorial and classic, Noto Serif Yezidi forms words as solid blocks, with diagonals slightly thinner than its verticals. Autour One holds fixed pressure like a stylus, so the heading is bold and the text quieter.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-odor-mean-chey: Odor Mean Chey has squeezed mouths on its a, e and s, and tall rounded lowercase forms. Odor Mean Chey would look cramped if the heading were made small, since Autour One's gentle monotone of line needs room to be bold.
